name: com.nakamafarsi.unity
description: Nakama Unity client (Heroic Labs) with the nakama-farsi layer built in: session and socket management, socket-first RPCs with HTTP fallback, typed wrappers for every nakama-farsi RPC, phone login, coins, web gateways, Cafe Bazaar and Myket billing, leaderboards, tasks, chat and stickers.

samples.description: Device login, socket, first reads, phone login.
Catalog, coins, Cafe Bazaar or Myket (test store in sandbox) and ZarinPal with the return to the game.
